newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Amgen stock gains.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Amgen stock gains.

text.p: Amgen Inc saw its stock price surge in after hours trading Monday, gaining on news that the biotechnology company had found an acceptable and safe dose range for its obesity treatment leptin in preliminary trials.
Dealers said Amgen was trading fairly actively at 62-3/4, 5/8 above an unofficial close of 62-1/8.
Amgen also said that the early data on leptin had encouraged the company to go ahead with Phase II clinical trials of leptin in obese patients with Type II diabetes.
Leptin is thought to help regulate body fat deposition and, as a result, produce weight loss.
"Otherwise it's quiet," a dealer said of the after hours trading session.

A handful of companies, including management systems company Reynolds and Reynolds and book story operator Crown Books, released quarterly earnings performances after the bell, but none traded noticeably out of line with closing prices.
The New York Stock Exchange said Monday's session one volume was 11,900, dropping from Friday's 103,400. Session two volume was 4,915,302, compared with Friday's 8,754,680.
